title: malaxis brachyrrhynchos
intro: Malaxis brachyrrhynchos, commonly known as the lesser butterfly orchid, is a species of orchid found in tropical forests. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis brachyrrhynchos include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis brachyrrhynchos include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
